_comment: What should be remembered from one chat message. expect: shared = a definition of work vocabulary (may count for the team), personal = saved for the user only (preference, a work fact that could change a future answer, private term), none = nothing saved (since 12 Nov this includes likes and opinions that would not change an answer), either = saving it privately or not at all are both fine. Used by scripts/eval_capture.py. The user is Tomas Vrba (R&D / A) in the pilot month, with memory and sharing on.
